description: Bitcoin: URPD (UTXO realized price distribution: how much supply last moved at each price) for the latest published block; `date` echoes the date served. Fields, units, price-grid rounding and weighting as in `get_urpd`.

cohort.description: A URPD cohort, by its series' prefix: an age aggregate (`all`, `sth`, `lth`, `age_under_4m`, ...) or an age band (`age_under_1h`, `age_1h_to_1d`, ...).

name: get_urpd_latest
title: Latest URPD
